thread:
kevin: Quick notes from design review: Summary vs Ledger for usage dashboard. Capturing decisions.
maria: Finance wants ledger by default for audits; PMs prefer summary for daily ops.
anya: proposal: default landing = Summary card, with a clear 'Open ledger' toggle to reveal full table. keeps both audiences happy.
mike: accessibility: when toggling to ledger, move keyboard focus to first row.
kevin: chart decision: stacked area (total) vs small multiples (per token type). proposal: add chart view toggle 'Totals / By token type'.
priya: copy: rename toggle to 'Summary / Ledger' and change export CTA to 'Download ledger CSV'.
maria: preferences: store per-user by default, allow org-level override for enterprise. key: dashboard.chart_view.
mike: a11y: ensure color contrast and include pattern fills for colorblind users.
anya: add pattern overlays in Figma a11y layer.
kevin: pagination > infinite scroll for large orgs. use server-side pagination, page size 200, 'Load more' button.
mike: 'Load more' must be focusable and announce new rows via aria-live.
anya: scoped filters: when filtering by project show breadcrumb 'Scoped to Project X [clear]'.
priya: CSV behavior: default to current scope, include 'Include all projects/orgs' checkbox for admins. columns should be stable: invoice_date, org_id, project_id, project_name, resource, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, embedding_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, cost_usd_raw.
mike: make embedding_tokens present always, use 0 when not applicable to avoid shifting columns.
anya: modal should show 3-row sample preview and column descriptions.
maria: action items: anya update Figma; mike add a11y checklist; priya update copy; jia to spec pagination and CSV invariants.
deploy-bot: branch dashboard-summary-ledger created; planned deploy 2026-08-02 02:30 UTC. tag @jia for rollout.
kevin: thanks, merging Figma EOD unless objections.
anya: lgtm
priya: will update copy doc
mike: will follow up on a11y tests
